name: vacation-manager
description: Vacation request management — Vue 3 + Node.js (Common Event Framework) + PostgreSQL/TypeORM

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.codegen: npm run codegen -w backend && npm run codegen:api -w frontend
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
